name: MatchingGiftTracker
tagline: Stop leaving corporate matching money on the table.
description: A complete matching gift app for nonprofits in one Power Platform control: employer match rules (ratio, minimum, annual cap, deadline, eligible employees, volunteer grants), automatic eligibility and expected match per gift, a claim workflow from identified to received with deadlines, reminders and variance checks, a kanban board, employer analytics and a claim file export.
features: Employer rules in plain text: ratio, minimum, annual cap, deadline, eligible employee types, volunteer grants, portal
Eligibility check and expected match per gift, annual cap per employee and year
Claim workflow with allowed transitions and required fields per status
Kanban board with drag-and-drop and keyboard Move menu
Employer analytics: realisation rate, days to payment
Bulk submit, reminders, claim file CSV, undo
